_comment: Gift types grouped by in-game tooltip category. Roughly 120 gift items exist; they are grouped by what the tooltip says they are enjoyed by, and most characters react well to any gift of a type matching their stated interests. The source page states its gift section is a work in progress, so recommended characters are recorded as reported rather than complete.
